messages:
alex_g: hey @support, running into weird promo credit behavior. I signed up and got the auto free trial (TRIAL2026) from the console. Then I applied promo SAVE50 from our marketing email. Console shows both promos in the account UI, but usage is only consuming SAVE50 credits and TRIAL2026 disappeared from the available balance. can you check?

billing-bot: Promo applied: TRIAL2026 (30-day trial) -> acct_ABC123 at 2026-02-25T14:02:10Z :information_source: 

maya_support: hey @alex_g — sorry about that. can you paste the exact steps + curl you used to apply SAVE50? also can you confirm account id (looks like acct_ABC123) and whether you used the dashboard or the /promos API? :eyes:

alex_g: sure — used the dashboard first (trial auto-grant), then from my CI hit the promos API to apply SAVE50. here's the exact request I used: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/promos/apply \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"acct_id":"acct_ABC123","code":"SAVE50"}'
```

response was 200 OK with body: `{ "status": "applied", "code": "SAVE50", "amount": 50 }` — dashboard then shows SAVE50 in credits and TRIAL2026 no longer listed under "active promos" (but the UI promo history shows it was granted).

maya_support: thanks. I tried to reproduce in staging quickly: grant trial via admin console, then call the same endpoint. I can reproduce the exact behavior — second apply removes the trial from the active list and the returned balance only reflects the most recently applied promo. looks like an overwrite. adding @raj_billing for billing rules confirmation.

raj_billing: tagging in. short version: there are two promo types in our system — "grant" (trial, auto-grants from console) and "coupon" (manual promo codes). Historically they stack unless the apply flow sets `replace=true`. We recently shipped a minor change to the API client which inadvertently changed the default `replace` behavior to true for idempotency reasons (commit ac4d9f). That makes the API call replace active promos rather than append. This explains why console-granted TRIAL2026 disappears after the API call. :thinking_face:

raj_billing: immediate notes: 
- root cause: API apply endpoint default changed to replace=true in patch.
- expected behavior: coupons with stackable=true should append and not wipe grants.
- impact: only customers who got a console grant + then called promos.apply without explicit replace=false are affected. likely a small subset but could be larger for customers automating promo application from CI.

sara_ops: can we get a quick query for number of affected accounts and a list for a backfill? we need to know if any accounts were actually billed incorrectly or just lost visible trial credits. I can run an emergency hotfix to switch default back if it's safe.

maya_support: @alex_g — workaround for you immediately: reapply TRIAL2026 from the admin console (it will re-grant the trial) or call the API with the explicit flag: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/promos/apply \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"acct_id":"acct_ABC123","code":"SAVE50","replace":false}'
```

that will append instead of replacing. we'll also run a backfill for affected accounts. sorry for the friction. :bow:

alex_g: ok thanks, i'll try reapplying the trial in the console now. one question — could any usage have been billed to us because the trial credit disappeared?

raj_billing: short answer: no charge should have passed through incorrectly — removing a grant only affects which credits are shown/consumed; billing pipelines look at token consumption vs available credits at evaluation time, and we didn't run a retroactive billing job. that said, we'll double-check invoice windows for the affected accounts just to be safe.

sara_ops: action items: 
- run query to find accounts where an admin grant exists in history but not active promos and a subsequent promos.apply was called within 24h (maya to provide sample query) — ETA 2h.
- decide hotfix vs rollback: if impacted count > 500 do hotfix + backfill; else toggle default back and run targeted re-grants — ETA for decision 1h.
- run backfill to restore grants for affected accounts (once list confirmed) — ETA 4h.

maya_support: i'll own customer comms and the backfill list. for now @alex_g, please reapply TRIAL2026 and confirm credits are visible; i'll follow up once we finish the backfill. again sorry about the UX. :heart:

alex_g: re-grant worked, trial is visible again. thanks for the fast response. appreciate the workaround and timeline.

maya_support: great — marking this thread for follow-up. we'll DM with the final list and confirmation when the backfill is done. :thumbsup:
